task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Open the drawer of the rectangular slanted cabinet and set the metallic phone with glass screen front inside.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架打开矩形斜柜的抽屉，将正面为玻璃屏幕的金属手机放入其中。
